diagnosis: The cart Deployment was scaled to 0 replicas about 30 s before the alert (ReplicaSet cart-78b98c8995 went 1 to 0, pod mt6zd deleted). With no ready pods, cart has no endpoints, so frontend-proxy requests to cart time out. That matches the journey failures, all on the cart step. The change log has no record of the scale-down. The only recorded change is the imageSlowLoad flag, which does not touch cart. The cart image, config, and service selector all look normal. Restoring cart to 1 replica is the smallest reversible fix.
